journeys.name: Founder/community
journeys.originalDescription: Interest/application → review/approval → orientation → share with five weekly → gather 2–10+ in homes/coffee shops/workplaces → CONNECT→WATCH→TALK→ACT→MULTIPLY → groups/host training/attendance/leader support → a new group/host forms. This supports, never replaces, local churches.

journeys.name: Recipient and volunteer accessibility
journeys.originalDescription: No account required to consume public share; accessible experience, optional sign-in, adjustable text/reduced motion, sensitive content/age safeguards, no pressured conversion tracking, consent-dependent contact and follow-up.
